Chat Customer Service Assistant (Meta & Digital Messaging)



Position Chat Customer Service Assistant  Team Marketing & Customer Experience

Type Full-Time / Remote  Reports To Marketing Manager



ABOUT THE ROLE



Taylor Contractors is a rapidly growing trade services company operating across New Zealand, with regional plumbing and electrical businesses servicing residential, commercial and civil clients.



We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly responsive Chat Customer Service Assistant to become the first point of contact for customers across all of our digital platforms.



Your primary responsibility is to engage every customer who contacts us through
, Instagram, Messenger, website live chat and other digital messaging channels, providing exceptional customer service while converting enquiries into booked jobs.



You will work closely with our Marketing Manager, Customer Service Team and Operations Team to ensure every lead receives a prompt, professional response and no opportunity is missed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Customer Engagement



• Respond to all
 Messenger 
 within 2 minutes during rostered hours.

• Collect customer name.

 address.

title: Google Ads Specialist (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist to handle the maintenance and optimization of one account with approximately 8–10 active campaigns. This is a remote freelance position for candidates based in the Philippines.



Important: We are not looking for beginners. The ideal candidate must currently work at a SEM agency or have previous proven experience managing professional Google Ads accounts. Knowledge of SEO would be a strong plus, as we value candidates who understand both paid and organic strategies.



Responsibilities include daily review of budget, conversions, and performance; bid adjustments and keyword optimization; monitoring ads (RSA), extensions, and key metrics (CTR, CPC, conversions); updating and managing negative keyword lists; creating new ad variations and conducting weekly A/B tests; and preparing a monthly performance report with insights and recommendations.



Requirements: proven experience working at a SEM agency or managing professional Google Ads accounts, strong knowledge of Google Ads and Google Analytics, ability to analyze and act on performance metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS), experience in ad copywriting and optimization, proactive and results-driven. SEO knowledge is considered a strong advantage.



Schedule and workload: part-time, approximately 2 hours per day (10–12 hours per week). Remote work with flexible hours, but daily checks are required.



We offer a competitive starting rate of 7 USD per hour, with flexibility depending on proven experience. The position includes a flexible schedule focused on results and the opportunity for long-term collaboration.



How to apply: please send your updated CV and examples of accounts or case studies you have worked on (no sensitive data required, just metrics or results), along with a short cover letter.

title: Short-Form Video Editing Assistant for Instagram Trial Reels
description:
I am looking for a reliable video editing assistant to create simple variations of completed short-form videos for Instagram Trial Reels.



This is a straightforward, repeatable editing job. You will receive a completed video, along with raw footage or project materials when needed. Most videos are one minute long or shorter.



Your job will be to create multiple variations of each completed video by making small changes such as:



* Horizontally flipping sections of the video that do not contain text

* Slightly zooming in or changing the framing

* Adding a 0.1-second black screen at the beginning

* Making minor adjustments to saturation, filters, brightness, or color

* Exporting and correctly naming each variation

* Uploading the finished versions to the correct Google Drive folder



A full guide with exact instructions and examples will be provided. Attention to detail matters, so include the word “Trial” somewhere in the middle of your application when describing your editing experience.



You should be available to process approximately three to five source videos per day. Each source video may require multiple variations.



Requirements:



* Experience using CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar editing software

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions exactly

* Reliable communication

* Fast internet and the ability to upload video files

* Organized file management

* Consistent daily availability



This is not advanced video editing. The original videos will already be edited. You are only making small adjustments and creating new variations.



To apply, please include:



1. The editing software you use

2. Your daily availability

3. Your experience editing short-form videos

4. A link to previous editing work

5. Confirmation that you are comfortable with a salary of $150 per month



Selected applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test.

title: AI Funnel Builder & Lead Generation Specialist | GoHighLevel & Automation
description:
About Nelaur Space



Nelaur Space is a growing AI automation and web solutions agency helping service-based businesses attract more customers and operate more efficiently. We build websites, sales funnels, CRM systems, AI chatbots, and automated workflows for businesses in international markets.



We are looking for a proactive and tech-savvy professional who can research qualified prospects and build reliable digital systems for our clients.

* Experienced with GoHighLevel, sales funnels, and workflow automation

* Technically capable and comfortable learning new platforms

* Skilled at researching businesses and identifying decision-makers

* Highly attentive to technical and visual details

* Organized, dependable, and consistent with deadlines

* Able to test your work thoroughly before delivery

* Comfortable troubleshooting problems independently

* Clear and professional in written and spoken English

* Receptive to feedback and committed to continuous improvement

* Interested in growing with an early-stage company over the long term



Key Responsibilities



Lead Generation and Research



* Research local service businesses that could benefit from our services.

* Identify relevant business owners and decision-makers.

* Collect accurate contact information from reliable sources.

* Qualify prospects according to our ideal client profile.

* Maintain a clean, accurate, and organized lead database.

* Remove duplicate, irrelevant, or outdated information.

* Submit regular reports on leads researched and qualified.



This part of the role focuses primarily on prospect research and database building. Sales calls and closing will be handled by the sales team unless otherwise agreed.



Sales Funnels and Website Development



* Build responsive landing pages and business websites.

* Create high-converting sales funnels in GoHighLevel.

* Design lead-capture forms, surveys, and booking pages.

* Connect domains and configure required technical settings.

* Optimize pages for mobile responsiveness and conversions.

* Test links, forms, buttons, tracking, and notifications before launch.

* Customize templates according to each client’s brand and objectives.



AI, CRM, and Workflow Automation



* Build and configure AI-powered chatbots.

* Set up GoHighLevel accounts, pipelines, calendars, and CRM systems.

* Create automated
 and SMS follow-up workflows.

* Configure lead assignment, reminders, notifications, and pipeline actions.

* Integrate calendars, forms, websites, and approved third-party tools.

* Connect platforms through Zapier, Make, or native integrations.

* Test every workflow thoroughly before client delivery.

* Monitor and troubleshoot automations when problems occur.



Project Delivery and Documentation



* Customize systems according to each client’s requirements.

* Complete assigned projects within agreed deadlines.

* Document account settings, workflows, integrations, and project changes.

* Provide clear progress updates and communicate potential delays early.

* Fix technical problems and complete requested revisions.

* Prepare completed systems for review and client handoff.

* Protect client information and maintain account confidentiality.



Required Skills



* GoHighLevel

* Sales funnel development

* Landing page or website creation

* CRM setup and pipeline configuration

*
 and SMS workflow automation

* AI chatbot configuration

* Lead research and data collection

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Ability to manage multiple assignments independently



Basic HTML and CSS knowledge is preferred.



Nice-to-Have Skills



* Zapier or Make

* WordPress

* Google Workspace

*
 Lead Ads integrations

* Domain and DNS configuration

* API or webhook integrations

* Basic SEO knowledge

* Conversion rate optimization

* Experience working with digital agencies



Performance Indicators



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



* Number of relevant, qualified leads researched each week

* Accuracy and completeness of lead information

* Number of funnels and websites completed

* Number of CRM systems and AI chatbots deployed

* Quality and reliability of completed automations

* Project completion time

* Ability to meet deadlines

* Accuracy of documentation

* Number of errors found after launch

* Client and internal team satisfaction



Specific targets will be explained during onboarding and adjusted according to workload.



Compensation and Benefits



* Base compensation of 3.5 per hour

* Reliable and timely payment

* Performance-based increases for consistently strong work

* Access to the tools and systems required for assigned projects

* Practical experience with AI automation and international clients

* Ongoing guidance, feedback, and professional development

* Long-term opportunity with a growing agency

* Potential advancement to Senior Automation Specialist, Technical Project Lead, or Automation Manager



Work Requirements



* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

* Backup plan for power or internet interruptions

* Availability for 6 hours per day

* Quiet and professional remote working environment

* Ability to track time and submit regular progress reports



How to Apply—Read Carefully



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



Use the following subject line:



"GREEN – AI Funnel Builder – [Your Full Name]"



Include the following information in your application:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit.

2. A link to your résumé.

3. Links to two or three funnels, websites, or automation projects you personally built.

4. A brief explanation of your exact contribution to each project.

5. A list of the GoHighLevel features you have used.

6. Details of your experience with AI chatbots, Zapier, Make, APIs, or webhooks.

7. An example of a complicated technical problem you solved.

8. The tools you use for lead research.

9. Your internet speed and backup arrangements.

10. Your earliest available starting date.



Please also record a short Loom video of no more than three minutes. In the video, show one funnel or automation you built and briefly explain how it works. Do not reveal confidential client information.



At the end of your application, answer this question:



"What steps would you take to test a GoHighLevel funnel and its automations before delivering it to a client?"



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, checks every detail, and delivers systems that function correctly—not just systems that look complete. If that describes you, we would be glad to review your application.

2.
:

:

Your resume

By taking these responsibilities off my plate, you’ll allow me to focus on growing the business while becoming an essential part of that journey.

?

As we learn each other’s working styles and my businesses continue to grow, I fully expect this role to grow as well, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time career for the right candidate.

?

 and calendar management

?

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

* Exceptional organizational and time management skills

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently

?

* Social media scheduling and management

* SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) creation

?

?

title: Vendor Compliance & QuickBooks Desktop Coordinator
description:
LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY: VENDOR COMPLIANCE & QUICKBOOKS DESKTOP COORDINATOR



FULL-TIME | REMOTE | $8–$12+ USD PER HOUR | 40 HOURS PER WEEK



Are you exceptionally organized, accurate, and fast on a computer?



A growing U.S.-based construction trucking and logistics company is hiring a full-time Vendor Compliance & QuickBooks Desktop Coordinator.



This is primarily a back-office compliance, document-review, onboarding, and data-entry position. You will review vendor documents, track missing or expiring records, support certified-payroll documentation, and enter approved freight bills into QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop.



Our operation supports approximately 70–150 trucks per day. You must be comfortable working with a high volume of documents, following detailed procedures, identifying discrepancies, and completing repetitive work without sacrificing accuracy.



This is a long-term position reporting directly to the Operations Manager. The company name will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. REVIEW AND MANAGE COMPLIANCE DOCUMENTS



You will collect, review, organize, and track documents such as:



• W-9 forms

• Certificates of Insurance

• Business licenses

• Driver’s licenses

• Medical cards

• CARB certificates

• DIR registrations

• Certified-payroll onboarding documents

• Payment release forms

• Payroll check documentation

• Audit-related records



You will verify that submitted documents are complete, current, legible, accurate, and consistent with company requirements.





2. SUPPORT VENDOR ONBOARDING AND FOLLOW-UP



You will:



• Send onboarding instructions and document requests

• Follow up through
 and company texting software

• Make occasional phone calls when necessary

• Explain which documents or corrections are still required

• Prepare lists of vendors requiring follow-up

• Maintain accurate onboarding and compliance statuses

• Organize completed vendor files for review

• Record communication and follow-up activity in company systems



After completing training and demonstrating a strong understanding of our requirements, you may be authorized to approve qualifying documents and place or remove designated compliance holds.





3. MAINTAIN CERTIFIED-PAYROLL, AUDIT, AND PROJECT RECORDS



You will:



• Create, distribute, and track certified-payroll onboarding documents

• Maintain project, vendor, and service-date records

• Collect and organize payment releases, payroll records, and audit documents

• Review submissions for missing or inconsistent information

• Update compliance trackers and our custom transportation-management system

• Prepare records for internal compliance and certified-payroll review

• Notify the appropriate tea
mber when documents are missing, inaccurate, expired, or overdue





4. ENTER FREIGHT BILLS INTO QUICKBOOKS ENTERPRISE DESKTOP



Approximately 8–10 hours per week will initially be dedicated to QuickBooks and accounts-payable data entry.



Trucking companies submit daily freight bills that must be reviewed and entered accurately as vendor bills.



You will:



• Review daily freight bills and bills of lading

• Confirm that submitted information matches approved source records

• Enter approved vendor bills into QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• Identify duplicate submissions, incorrect rates, missing backup, and other discrepancies

• Contact vendors when corrections are required

• Attach or organize supporting documents

• Complete limited reconciliation and document-matching work

• Escalate unusual discrepancies instead of making unsupported accounting decisions



Information and coding instructions will generally be provided from approved sources. This position does not require you to independently make complex accounting decisions.





5. COORDINATE WITH OUR INTERNAL TEAM



You will:



• Keep the Operations Manager informed of unresolved issues

• Communicate vendor status to Dispatch, Accounting, and Compliance

• Maintain accurate spreadsheets, digital files, and system notes

• Provide concise updates on completed work, pending items, and discrepancies

• Follow established procedures and ask questions when something is unclear

• Protect confidential vendor, driver, payroll, and company information





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



To qualify, you must have:



• At least 2 years of experience in administrative support, document control, compliance, bookkeeping support, accounts payable, data entry, or another accuracy-focused role



• Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Desktop



• Experience with QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop is strongly preferred



• Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Docs, and digital file-management systems



• Strong PDF skills, including editing text, combining files, separating pages, renaming files, and organizing high volumes of documents



• Strong written and spoken English



• Excellent reading comprehension and the ability to follow detailed written procedures



• A reliable computer, strong internet, backup internet, backup power, webcam, microphone or headset, and a quiet workspace





THE RIGHT PERSON FOR THIS ROLE



You will be successful if you are:



• Extremely attentive to detail

• Fast and proficient on a computer

• Comfortable with repetitive, high-volume work

• Able to identify inconsistencies instead of blindly entering information

• Organized and disciplined with follow-up

• Comfortable learning many different document types

• Willing to ask questions instead of guessing

• Reliable without constant supervision

• Professional when handling confidential records

• Receptive to feedback

• Interested in staying with one company long-term





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience in any of the following is helpful, but we are willing to train a highly capable candidate:



• QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• High-volume vendor-bill entry

• Accounts payable

• Vendor or subcontractor onboarding

• Compliance-document review

• Certificates of Insurance

• Certified payroll

• U.S. construction administration

• Trucking or transportation administration

• Insurance-document processing

• Reconciliation

• Custom compliance or document-management systems





SYSTEMS YOU WILL USE



• QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• Microsoft Excel

• Google Sheets

• Gmail and Google Workspace

• PDF editing and document-management software

• Custom transportation-management and compliance software

• Secure remote-access and VPN tools

• Company
 and texting systems

• Approved time-tracking software



Training will be provided for our company-specific systems, compliance requirements, approval procedures, certified-payroll processes, and freight-bill review procedures.





WORK SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week independent contractor position, Monday through Friday.



The initial training period will require substantial overlap with Pacific Time business hours. This may require evening or overnight working hours in the Philippines.



Once you are fully trained and consistently completing work accurately:



• At least 4–5 hours of your shift must overlap with Pacific Time business hours

• The remainder of your working hours may become more flexible

• Independent document-processing and data-entry tasks may be completed after U.S. business hours



The final schedule will be agreed upon before hiring.





TRAINING AND ACCOUNTABILITY



During training and the paid probationary period, you must be available for:



• Live video training

• Frequent screen sharing

• Scheduled working sessions

• Quality and workflow reviews

• Regular check-ins with the Operations Manager

• Time tracking through the company’s approved system

• Daily reporting of completed, pending, and unresolved work



As you demonstrate reliability, accuracy, responsiveness, and the ability to work independently, live supervision may be reduced and your schedule may become more flexible.





EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



• A reliable computer capable of supporting remote access

• Strong and stable primary internet

• A dependable backup internet connection

• Backup power for outages

• A working webcam

• A clear microphone or professional headset

• A quiet and professional workspace

• The ability to participate in video meetings and share your screen





COMPENSATION



$8–$12 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



Higher compensation may be considered for an exceptional candidate with strong experience in:



• QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• High-volume accounts-payable entry

• Compliance-document review

• Construction or trucking administration

• Certified payroll

• Vendor onboarding

• Reconciliation and discrepancy identification



We are looking for someone who wants stable, long-term work and the opportunity to take on greater responsibility over time.





PAID ASSESSMENT AND PROBATIONARY PERIOD



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a brief paid practical assessment.



The assessment may include:



• Reviewing a sample vendor file

• Identifying missing or inaccurate documents

• Updating a document-expiration tracker

• Reviewing sample freight bills

• Entering sample transaction information

• Identifying an incorrect rate, duplicate submission, missing attachment, or other discrepancy



The selected applicant will begin with a paid probationary period.





GROWTH POTENTIAL



After demonstrating a strong understanding of our procedures, you may receive greater responsibility for:



• Approving compliance documents

• Managing vendor compliance statuses

• Placing or removing designated compliance holds

• Reviewing more complex discrepancies

• Improving document-management processes

• Creating procedures and checklists

• Training future administrative tea
mbers





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph using this subject line:



ACCURATE DOCUMENTS – [YOUR FULL NAME]



Your application must include:



1. Your resume.



2. A brief explanation of your experience with document review, compliance, vendor onboarding, bookkeeping support, accounts payable, or high-volume data entry.



3. The exact QuickBooks products and versions you have used. Clearly state whether you have experience with:



• QuickBooks Desktop

• QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

• QuickBooks Online



4. A description of the highest volume of documents or transactions you have processed in a previous position.



5. Your available working hours in both Philippine Time and Pacific Time.



6. Your desired hourly rate in USD.



7. A screenshot of a current internet-speed test.



8. A description of your:



• Computer specifications

• Primary internet connection

• Backup internet connection

• Backup power

• Webcam

• Microphone or headset

• Home-office environment



9. Answer this scenario in 3–5 sentences:



You are reviewing a freight bill and notice that the rate does not match the approved information. A required supporting document is also missing. What would you do before entering the bill into QuickBooks?



10. At the end of your application, include the exact words:



I CHECK BEFORE I ENTER





WHAT HAPPENS AFTER YOU APPLY



Qualified applicants will move through the following process:



1. Application review

2. Short video interview

3. Paid practical assessment

4. Final interview with the Operations Manager

5. Reference check

6. Paid probationary period

7. Long-term full-time engagement



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant Wanted.



We are in need of a skilled Executive Assistant who is highly organized, proactive, and operations-minded who can serve as a dependable right hand and help keep projects, people, and priorities moving forward.



This person will support Ryan and Alex directly across business, content, operations, contractors, and light business admin.



Someone who can successfully do all of the following responsibilities without the owners having to follow up (to see if they were done correctly or done at all) or step in and do them.



The EA Will:

1. Communicate daily with Ryan and Alex to get necessary information for duties, understand the scope of what we're building, our messaging, and our offers. Check in with updates on current tasks and offer feedback and insights along the way.



2. Help Alex set up a calendar in GoHighLevel that links with his Google Calendar so clients can book directly rather than coordinating times back and forth manually. Track and schedule both personal and business appointments with calendars linked so blocking off time on one blocks time on the other.



3. Maintain Ryan's calendars in GHL for booking discovery calls and keep his availability up to date.



4. Download Zoom recordings, trim them, and upload to Google Drive for archiving.



5. Create instruction manuals for each employee role in the business so all processes are documented and could be used to train a new employee when turnover happens.



6. Manage operations and make sure processes run smoothly.



7. Maintain workflows tied to all projects and create documents detailing those workflows to be included in the instruction manuals.



8. Offer feedback on how all processes and products could be improved.



For launches:

-Set KPIs for the success of the launch: conversion rates,
 open rates, upsell percentages, etc.

-Track low ticket offer performance post-launch using split tests set up by our sales funnel builder and make suggestions on funnel improvements based on the data.

-Make sure all content created for the launch looks professional and meets Alex's standard for publication. Get feedback from him and communicate back to contractors what needs to be changed. (Content includes all
 ad videos, module videos and workbooks, and how things appear in the membership portal. We don't expect you to make these changes yourself.)

-Test our software and technical tools to make sure user experience is smooth (landing pages, webinar functionality, etc.).



About the Role:

This is a fully remote part-time position requiring 20-25 hours per week to start, with the option to increase to full-time (35-40 hours).



Pay is $6-$7/hour depending on experience. There will be a two-month trial period starting at $5/hour. After a 6-month performance review, we will determine an increase in pay to $7-$8/hour.



Working hours are 11am-7pm MDT. You will track your time using Toggl and payroll is processed every two weeks on Mondays. You will have PTO for national and special Philippine holidays, plus 10 days/year of PTO if the role becomes full-time.



Are You the Right Fit?



Ask yourself:



Are you exceptionally organized and able to manage multiple moving parts at once?

Are you strong at follow-through and not satisfied with tasks sitting unfinished?

Are you comfortable with recurring systems and routines, including checklists, SOPs, and repeatable workflows?

Are you an excellent note-taker who can clearly capture action items and next steps?

Are you trustworthy and discreet, especially with inboxes, internal operations, and sensitive information?

Are you calm under pressure, especially when priorities shift or several things need attention at once?



If so, please read through the entire job announcement before applying.



About InnerShift:

InnerShift is a personality-focused coaching and personal development company helping entrepreneurs and leaders uncover their authentic identity and build businesses aligned with who they really are. We are a small, fast-moving team and this role is central to keeping everything running well.





Our Tech Stack:

Since you will need to work efficiently on assigned tasks with little assistance, ideally you will have working knowledge of products in our tech stack. If not, we will provide training through screen recordings, onboarding documents, and Zoom calls. You MUST be willing to use Google and YouTube to learn the software required for your job.



GoHighLevel (GHL)

Google Workspace (Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets)

Zoom

Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools (required competency)



Of the qualified applicants, we will prioritize those with more familiarity with our tech stack.



Requirements:

GoHighLevel experience

Strong Google Drive organization skills

Experience with Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools

Familiar with Zoom settings, setting up meetings, and downloading recordings

Strong English writing and speaking skills (C1 on the CEFR framework)

Able to manage projects and several moving parts while communicating between all responsible parties

Detail-oriented and meticulous, double-checks work before submitting

Proactive and resourceful, able to notice gaps, flag issues, and ask smart questions

Tech-comfortable and able to learn new systems



How to Apply:



If your interest is piqued, please reply to this job post and do the following:



1. What is the name of the coaching methodology Alex developed?

2. Read about how clients work with Ryan and Alex at 
.

3. In the subject line, include only the title of one book from the Leadership section of our recommended reading list and the number of years you have worked as an EA or admin.

4. Include a quality headshot according to the requirements found on this page: 
/photos. (You do NOT need to send a video of you walking.)

5. List which softwares in our tech stack you already know how to use and your approximate proficiency of each on a scale of 1-10.

6. Do not send a resume.

7. Tell us whether or not you already have a day job.

8. Let us know how many hours you are available to work each week, for example 20, 25, or 30.

9. Your application will be disqualified if you
 us directly, send a resume, write a subject line like 'I'm your next rockstar', or follow us on social media.



Please only apply if you are super detail-oriented and beyond organized. You must have at least 2 years of work experience in the admin or EA space for an online business.



We are looking to bring you on board and want you to be a part of our dynamic, small but fun team. We're looking for you to grow with us!



We will consider applicants who are able to successfully fulfill all criteria above.



Thank you for taking the time to apply.

title: NDIS Marketing Assisstant
description:
MUST HAVE NDIS ALLED HEALTH MARKETING EXPERIENCE



We're a growing NDIS allied health practice on the Gold Coast, and we're looking for a sharp marketing assistant who already understands the NDIS ecosystem.



This is not a "post pretty graphics and hope" role. Our growth comes from referral relationships: Support Coordinators, Plan Managers, Local Area Coordinators, GPs, and other providers. You'll be helping us stay visible, credible, and top-of-mind with those people, while staying strictly compliant with NDIS advertising expectations and the NDIS Code of Conduct.



What you'll do



Plan and schedule content across LinkedIn,
 and Instagram, written for a referrer audience

Build and send EDM campaigns to our referrer database

Design collateral in Canva using our brand kit - service flyers, referral one-pagers, social tiles, capability statements

Maintain and improve our website copy and SEO for local NDIS search terms

Keep our listings current on NDIS provider directories

Track referral sources and campaign performance, and report on what's actually generating enquiries

Draft plain-English, accessible content suitable for participants, families and carers

Help build a simple referrer nurture sequence so warm contacts don't go cold



What you must have



Demonstrated marketing experience with Australian NDIS, allied health, aged care or disability providers - please tell us specifically which

A genuine working understanding of the NDIS: plan management types, the difference between a Support Coordinator and a Plan Manager, how participants find and choose providers

Awareness of NDIS advertising and conduct requirements - including consent and privacy when using participant stories or images

Strong written English. Your copy will be read by Australian clinicians and coordinators, so it needs to sound professional and human, not AI-generic

Canva, Meta Business Suite, and
 marketing platform experience 

Ability to work independently, ask good questions, and flag problems early

Reliable internet and availability overlapping Australian Eastern Standard Time

title: VA Remote Receptionist — Quick Onboarding, Long-Term Role
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



**(4)** Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



**(5)** Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired?



**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. title: Ads Manager / Creative Strategist (Research, Copy & Static Ad Design)
description:
Ads Manager / Creative Strategist (Remote, Full-Time, Long-Term)



Company: Banner Mountain Media

Location: Remote

Role: Ads Manager / Creative Strategist (Research, Copy & Static Ad Design)

Commitment: Full-Time, Long-Term



About Us



Banner Mountain Media is a U.S.-based video production and marketing agency serving home-service businesses, real estate firms, and architecture studios. We run paid advertising that drives real leads (phone calls and form fills) for local businesses, paired with high-quality creative produced in-house.



Role Overview



This is a creative strategist who also runs the ad accounts.



Most of your week is the front half of the work: researching what to say, writing it, and designing it. Then you launch it, read the numbers, and do it again. Research, copywriting, and static ad design are the three things this role lives or dies on. They are not bonus skills here. They are the job.



We need someone who can find the angle before they design anything. That means digging through the Meta Ad Library to see what competitors are running, reading customer reviews to find the words real buyers actually use, and understanding the offer well enough to know which promise will land. Then writing the headline and primary text that carries it. Then building the static ad that delivers it, from the client's own photography, with clean layout and deliberate type hierarchy.



You d
 what to test next, research it, write it, design it, launch it, and prove what worked. Real budget, real creative ownership, results-first.



This role requires consistent availability, reliable performance, and a long-term commitment.



What You Will Do



Research before you create. Tear down competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library, mine customer reviews and sales calls for the language buyers actually use, study the offer, and come back with angles worth testing rather than guesses.



Write the copy. Headlines, primary text, hooks, and CTAs built on direct-response fundamentals. You write to a specific person with a specific problem, not to a general audience.



Design the static ads end to end: layout, typography, composition, and brand consistency across a set of variations that each test a distinct angle.



Work from real client photography (home-service jobs, real estate, architecture) rather than stock. Crop, retouch, and compose it into ads that hold up at thumbnail size.



Own the creative test loop: pick the angle, make the ad, launch it, read the result, and brief our video editors on what to cut next based on what is winning.



Build the full funnel (top, middle, bottom): each new creative tests a clear angle, and winners graduate into more variations.



Own day-to-day buying across Meta and Google Ads for several clients at once: account structure, audiences, budgets, bid strategy, and conversion tracking.



Watch performance daily. Kill underperformers, scale winners, and keep spend pacing to budget against CPL and ROAS targets.



Set up and verify tracking end to end: pixels, conversion events, GA4, UTMs, and CRM/offline conversions.



Report results on a clear schedule in plain numbers and plain language.



Flag policy and compliance risk before launch (Special Ad Categories, financing claims, and similar).



Required Skills & Experience



RESEARCH. You have a repeatable way of finding angles before you create: Meta Ad Library teardowns, competitor analysis, review and testimonial mining, and offer research. You can explain where a winning angle came from, not just that it won.



COPYWRITING. You write ad copy that converts, not copy that describes. Headlines, primary text, hooks, and CTAs. You understand direct-response basics: one clear promise, a specific audience, and a reason to act now. Clear, plain English with no filler.



GRAPHIC DESIGN FOR ADS. You can build a static ad from a client photo with clean layout, deliberate type hierarchy, and consistent branding, and you can explain why it is laid out that way. Not stock photos with a logo dropped on top.



Fluent in a real design tool: Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, or Canva Pro. You work in layers and can hand off editable files.



Proven static ad experience specifically. Feed, story, and square formats, designed for mobile and legible at thumbnail size.



3+ years hands-on buying on both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (not boosting posts, not a single platform).



Proven lead-generation experience for local or service businesses (driving calls and form leads, not only e-commerce ROAS).



A track record you can show with real numbers: an account you took from one cost-per-lead to a lower one, or scaled spend while holding CPL/ROAS, plus the ads you researched, wrote and designed for it.



Strong conversion-tracking skills: pixels, GA4, conversion events, and UTM discipline.



Comfortable managing multiple accounts at once without dropping the ball.



Stable high-speed internet and full-time availability with US business-hours overlap.



Preferred (but not required)



Photo retouching and colour correction on real, imperfect field photography.



Landing page copy and CRO instinct (knowing when the problem is the page, not the ad).



Short-form video sense (you can cut or storyboard a Reel/TikTok, or brief an editor precisely).



Motion or animated static ads.



GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM experience.



TikTok and YouTube ads.



Google Local Services Ads (LSA) for home-service clients.



What We Provide



Real budgets and real ownership of client ad accounts and their creative.



A steady supply of original client photography and video to design from. You will not be stuck with stock.



Consistent monthly workload and stable long-term projects.



Clear targets, SOPs, and an in-house video team that turns your briefs into finished assets.



Direct communication with the founder and the rest of the team.



Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and performance.



How to Apply



The first three items matter most. We can read a resume; we cannot read your judgment without them.



1. A research example. Walk us through one angle you found and where it came from. What did you look at, what did you notice, and what did you test because of it?



2. Two or three pieces of ad copy you wrote, with the result if you have it. Headline and primary text is fine. Tell us who it was written for.



3. Three to five static image ads you personally designed, with one line each on the angle it tested and what happened. Send the ads themselves, not just a portfolio link.



4. The design tools you work in (Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, Canva Pro) and which one you are fastest in.



5. The platforms you have run and roughly how much total ad spend you have managed.



6. One specific result with numbers (cost-per-lead before and after, or a scale while holding CPL/ROAS).



7. The rest of your tools (confir
ta Ads Manager and Google Ads; list GA4, GHL, TikTok, LSA, GTM if you have them).



8. Your expected monthly full-time rate.



9. Your normal working hours and timezone, and confirmation you can commit full-time and long-term.



One more thing, and it is deliberate: when you fill out the intake form we send you, the question about the scheduling and analytics tools you use must be answered starting with the word "northstar". We read every application, and this tells us who reads every job post.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Funnel Cloning Specialist – Frontend & Backend (Bizopp / Direct Response)
description:
ABOUT US



EVERGREEN APPS is a UK-based performance marketing agency working in bizopp and direct response. A large part of what we do is relaunching offers: a client gives us existing funnel, and we rebuild it as a clean duplicate on new infrastructure so it can go live again fresh.



To be clear on scope: the source funnels are supplied by our clients and are their own property. This is rebuild-and-relaunch work, not scraping other people's assets.





THE ROLE



You take a working funnel and reproduce it completely, frontend and backend, on new infrastructure.



Frontend: rebuild every page in the flow — advertorial, VSL page, order form, upsells, downsells, thank you page. Match the layout, styling and behaviour. Handle the mobile version properly, not as an afterthought. Swap domains, branding and copy where the relaunch calls for it.



Backend: this is where most applicants fall down and where we actually need you. Rebuild the CRM and automation layer in GoHighLevel. Reconnect payment processing and order bumps. Rewire the tracking stack — pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs, server-side events — so attribution is intact from click through to purchase. Rebuild
 and SMS sequences. Set up domains, DNS, SSL and hosting.



Then you test the whole thing yourself. Every button, every step, every trigger, a real test transaction, and a tracking check that fires correctly. We should never be the ones to find a broken link.





WHAT WE NEED



Real experience cloning or rebuilding direct response funnels. Bizopp or make-money experience strongly preferred, because you'll already understand the flow structure and the compliance sensitivities.



Strong AI and clone prompting skills. Solid HTML and CSS — enough to rebuild a page by hand rather than approximate it in a builder.



Genuine competence with tracking. If you can't explain how a conversion event gets from a landing page to Meta's servers, this role isn't for you.



Comfort with domains, DNS, hosting and SSL. Fast, meticulous, and able to spot the difference between "looks the same" and "is the same".





TO APPLY



Send links to funnels you have cloned or rebuilt, and describe what you actually did on each — frontend, backend, or both.



Tell us which CRM and tracking stack you used.



Tell us about a time a rebuild broke something and how you caught it.



Start your message with the word RELAUNCH so we know you read this.



Applications without specific examples will be deleted unread.

title: Content & Copy Strategist
description:
ABOUT EPYC MEDIA

EPYC Media is a cultural storytelling agency known for building network ready content ecosystems for culturally influential founders, brands, athletes, entertainers, non profits, and enterprises. We believe story comes before format, emotional resonance creates audience loyalty, and premium production is a form of respect for the audience. The best content doesn't interrupt culture, it becomes part of it. Most of our team has been with EPYC 5+ years, because the work asks a lot of you (real detail, real craft, real effort) but it also moves the needle.



THE ROLE

Across several shows per week (a number that evolves quarter to quarter as the network grows), EPYC needs someone who knows how to get inside a client's voice and leverage AI to finalize deliverables quickly, while creatively crafting, choosing, and aligning on brand voice to create custom copy for every single episode. Every client has a production bible and a trained AI channel built specifically for their voice. This role sits between our editors and our design team, turning transcripts and AI-assisted drafts into final copy and direction that shapes how each show is seen. For the first 90 days, all copy and direction goes through our Project Manager for full sign-off. After that, review shifts to spot-checks only.



WEEKLY VOLUME (PER SHOW, ACROSS SEVERAL SHOWS PER WEEK)

3 reels needing custom cover copy

2 YouTube thumbnails

1 YouTube segment

1 carousel swipe post

1 episode title

Episode trailer direction, as needed, across shows



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Reel Cover Copy: custom copy for every reel, per episode, per show, per week.

YouTube Thumbnail Copy: direction and copy for thumbnails, handed to the Graphic Designer for execution.

YouTube Segment Copy: reviewing segment cuts to choose copy that earns the click.

Carousel Swipe Post Copy: copy across each swipe post, per show, per week.

Episode Titles: selecting titles that fit the show's voice and earn attention.

Episode Trailer Direction: creative direction and copy alignment for trailers, ensuring brand consistency across the network.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Genuine care for the details of custom storytelling and content creation.

Some copywriting experience.

Obsessive brand-voice range: able to hold several distinct show voices in your head at once, without them bleeding into each other.

Comfortable working inside a system: production bibles, trained AI prompts, and established workflows, rather than needing to invent from a blank page.

Comfortable giving direction, not just copy: confident shaping trailer concepts and defending creative calls.



TOOLS

ClickUp, Slack, Google Drive, EPYC's trained AI channel (per-client production)



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 90, you're independently creating custom copy for several shows, for every episode, with only spot-check review from our Project Manager, not full sign-off. Your copy helps each show grow, build traction, and attract new traffic, because it speaks directly to that client's ideal audience.

nt in raw footage that makes someone stop scrolling.

We're growing, and we need someone who can sit right in the middle of our design and development world and keep everything moving.



The Role



This is primarily a Website Project Manager position with a graphic design component. You'll be the connective tissue between our design team, our development team, and our clients, making sure website builds and hosting accounts run smoothly, on time, and without anything falling through the cracks.



You won't just be ticking boxes on a project board. You'll be the person clients trust, the person developers rely on for clear briefs, and the person our directors know can be handed a project and walked away from with total confidence.



What you'll be doing

Managing new website build projects end to end, from kickoff through to launch

Overseeing ongoing hosting clients, handling requests, updates, and troubleshooting coordination

Acting as the primary link between our design and development teams, translating client needs into clear, actionable briefs

Building and maintaining genuine relationships with our Australian based clients, including running video meetings when required

Keeping projects on schedule, flagging risks early, and solving problems before they become fires

Contributing design work where needed, particularly for smaller website and graphic tasks

Using tools like BugHerd for QA and feedback, and Loom for async updates and walkthroughs

What You'll Need

Fluent English, written and spoken. You'll be meeting with Australian clients directly, so this isn't negotiable

Solid working knowledge of WordPress, including page builders and everyday site management

Familiarity with Shopify, enough to manage builds and liaise confidently with developers

Proven experience in project management, ideally in a web, digital, or creative agency setting

A genuine knack for relationship building. You need to be the kind of person clients actually enjoy dealing with

Strong organisational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects without losing your head

A design eye. You don't need to be a senior designer, but you should be comfortable in tools like Figma, Canva, or Adobe

Bonus points for

Experience with BugHerd, Loom, or similar QA and communication tools

Background in a digital marketing agency environment

Exposure to SEO, hosting, or basic web troubleshooting

Why This Role Is Different



This isn't a dead end job. We're building out our team structure with real progression in mind, and this role has a clear path to grow in responsibility as the agency scales. If you're someone who wants to build a career rather than just clock hours, this is a seat worth taking.



You'll be working directly with the Australian directors, given real ownership over projects, and trusted to make decisions. We're not interested in micromanaging good people. We're interested in finding good people and getting out of their way.



How to Apply



Send through your CV along with a short note on:



A website project you managed from start to finish, and what made it a success (or what you learned when it didn't go to plan)

A quick example of your English communication, ideally something client-facing

Any design work you're proud to show off.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not just fill a seat. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:



- Company
 Page:





[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

description:
Job Code: 260805B_Music Coordinator / Admin Assistant (RAxBSM)

Full-Time | Remote | 5am-12pm Philippines Time

Starting Rate: $4-$6/hour



Please note that our account here is only active for a limited time. After that, we won't be able to respond to messages and our links will be deactivated. If you're coming across this after the fact, search for Rareform Audio online and reach out to us directly through our website.



Please read this post carefully before applying. Attention to detail is very important for this role.



To apply, you must submit a Loom video link through the application form below. If you do not include a Loom link specifically, your application will not be considered. Please do not send a Google Drive link, Dropbox link, YouTube link, or written-only application instead.



Apply here:





Who We Are



Rareform Audio and Black Sheep Music are a music and sound company specializing in music for movie trailers, advertising, film, TV, and media. We create and license music for major campaigns around the world, and we work with clients who often need things quickly, clearly, and professionally.



We are a small company, so people on our team often wear multiple hats depending on their strengths. We like growing with the people we invest in. More than anything, we are looking for someone sharp, reliable, accountable, detail-oriented, and eager to learn.



The Role



We are looking for a Music Coordinator / Admin Assistant to help coordinate projects between our clients and our internal team.



This is not a high-level music supervisor role. You do not need to be an expert in trailer music, playlisting, or music licensing. Music production skills are a huge plus, but they are not required.



The most important thing is that you are organized, trustworthy, responsive, and able to help keep things moving.



You will help with client requests, stem deliveries, project notes, team follow-ups, file organization, and general coordination. Over time, the role may grow based on your strengths.



Hours



The required schedule is Monday-Friday, 5am-12pm Philippines time, which is 2pm-9pm Los Angeles time during daylight savings.



This gives us overlap with Los Angeles clients and allows us to handle time-sensitive requests while the U.S. workday is still active.



What You’ll Help With



- Coordinating client requests between our clients and team

- Helping with stem requests, instrumentals, alternate mixes, and file deliveries

- Organizing project details, notes, links, files, and follow-ups

- Communicating clearly with our internal team of composers and roster of talent

- Making sure requests do not fall through the cracks

- Helping with basic admin, research, and outreach tasks when needed

- Supporting Rareform Audio and Black Sheep Music across different projects



What We’re Looking For



- An infinite learner

- Excellent written English

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable and accountable

- Organized and able to track multiple moving pieces

- Comfortable with Gmail, Notion, Dropbox and online tools

- Able to follow instructions carefully

- Able to work independently once trained

- Interested in music, media, trailers, film, TV, advertising, or creative work

- Willing to learn new systems and improve over time



Musical experience is a plus, especially if you produce music, sing, play an instrument, edit videos, create content, or have worked around artists, labels, studios, playlists, or music promotion. But the main thing we need is someone sharp who can help us coordinate and stay organized.



This Role Is a Good Fit If



- You enjoy helping things stay organized

- You are careful with details

- You communicate clearly

- You take ownership of your work

- You like learning new things

- You are calm and professional

- You want to grow with a small creative company



This Role Is NOT a Good Fit If



- You do not follow instructions carefully

- You need constant supervision for every small step

- You are careless with spelling, communication, or details

- You are not available from 5am-12pm Philippines time

- You are looking for a role with no responsibility

- You are not interested in music or creative work



How to Apply



Please apply through this form, not through messages on this website:







In your Loom video, please answer these 3 questions:



1. Tell us a little about yourself, your background, and why this role interests you.



2. Show us one project or piece of work you are proud of. Impress us.. What's something interesting you have created, This could be a spreadsheet, Canva design, music project, YouTube upload, research list, admin system, social media work, video, outreach campaign, or anything else you personally worked on. Tell us what the goal was, what you did, and what the result was.



3. Why do you think you would be a strong fit for a music coordination / admin assistant role?



The Loom video does not need to be fancy. We just want to hear you communicate clearly, follow instructions, and show us something real that you have done.



Again, applications without a Loom video link will not be considered.



We are not looking for a perfect resume. We are looking for someone sharp, reliable, honest, detail-oriented, and excited to grow.
salary: $4-$6 per hour depending on skill level
