title: Reddit Content Writer & Subreddit Manager
description:
About the role



We run Reddit growth and content programs for our clients. We're looking for one strong writer to join our team on Slack and become our go-to person for anything that gets posted to Reddit.



Two things make this job different from a typical content writing gig:



1. The writing has to be genuinely yours. A lot of what we send you will start as an AI draft. Your job is to throw out the wording and rewrite it as a real person — keep the meaning, change everything else. We check every piece against an AI-detection tool and it needs to come back 100% human. To be clear: we are not looking for someone who runs text through a "humanizer" tool. Those get caught. We want an actual human writing actual sentences.



2. Speed matters more than volume. Most pieces are short — 50 to 120 words. We'll send them to you in Slack, you rewrite, you send them back, we post. Turnaround is usually measured in minutes, not days. That's why we need someone reachable during the workday rather than someone who batches everything at midnight.



What you'll do



- Rewrite AI-drafted Reddit posts, comments, and replies into natural human writing that passes AI-detectors at 100% human

- Manage and grow one of our subreddits — plan what gets posted, write the posts, seed discussion, keep the community active

- Answer Reddit questions on behalf of our clients in a voice that sounds like a real person who knows the topic

Use AI (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to research and generate content angles across client niches you've never worked in before — then write the actual content yourself

- Stay responsive on Slack during agreed hours for quick-turn requests

- This job will evolve over time, so be flexible and we will too!



Requirements

- Native-level written and spoken English. This is non-negotiable. Reddit users notice awkward phrasing immediately, and so do we.

- Heavy personal Reddit experience. You should be an actual Redditor — you know how different subs behave, what gets upvoted, what gets you downvoted into oblivion, and why most marketing on Reddit fails. Tell us your favorite subs.

- You understand Reddit's rules on self-promotion and disclosure, and how to work inside them so accounts don't get shadowbanned

- Strong AI skills for ideation and research — you can take a vertical you know nothing about (roofing, dental SaaS, freight brokerage, whatever) and get up to speed fast enough to write about it credibly

- Reliable internet and a workspace where you can be on Slack during your shift

- Comfortable with fast, informal, high-volume back-and-forth communication

- Background in online marketing, SEO, or agency work



Nice to have



- Experience moderating a subreddit or running an online community

- Experience writing in multiple brand voices



Hours & pay



- Availability during Pacific Timezone work hours, Monday–Friday

- Monthly retainer, depending on experience and test results



This is a long-term role. We're hiring one person and we want to keep them.



How to apply



Please do the following — applications that skip any step will be ignored.



1. Start your message with the word UPVOTE so we know you read the whole post.



2. Tell us your Reddit experience: how long you've been on the platform, what kinds of subs you're active in, and anything you've grown or moderated.



3. Rewrite the paragraph below in your own words. Keep the meaning, change the wording completely.



Test paragraph: I've been using project management software for about three years now and I think the biggest mistake teams make is choosing a tool before they understand their own workflow. It's very easy to get impressed by feature lists and end up with something overly complicated. My advice would be to start simple and only add complexity when you actually feel the pain of not having it.



Tell us which hours you can realistically be online, in Pacific timezone.



We reply to everyone who completes all four steps.

description:
Full-Time · Long-Term · Philippines (Remote)

Pay: $5.00–$7.00 USD/hour depending on experience Schedule: 40 hrs/week over 5 days, US Eastern Time — see "The honest version" below Type: Full-time, exclusive employment Start: Paid 2-week trial ? permanent



Before you apply



We're hiring one person for a role we want to be someone's home for years — not a gig, not a rotating bench of freelancers. That means a stable schedule, a fair rate paid on time, real benefits, and room to grow. In return, we're looking for someone who's genuinely happy doing this work well, day in and day out.



This post is longer and more detailed than most, on purpose. We'd rather tell you exactly what the job is — the good and the hard parts — so you can d
 honestly whether it fits your life. The best hires we've ever made are the ones who read all of this, recognized themselves in it, and thought "yes, that's me." If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.



The honest version of this job



The schedule is US Eastern hours, 5 days a week — roughly 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine time, with two days off. That's standard for most VA roles, so it may already be your normal. Some of your working days may fall on weekends; we'll agree your fixed days off together so you can plan your life around them.



It's the same work most days. Order status. Where's my package. Refund requests. Warranty claims. Someone who is angry about something that isn't your fault. The variety is in the people, not the tasks. If you need novelty to stay engaged, you'll be unhappy here.



You'll have a team around you. Two other support specialists work these same hours from the Philippines, and you'll report to our Customer Service Manager, who works alongside you on a similar schedule. You won't be isolated — you'll have people to ask, learn from, and lean on. We still need someone self-motivated: the best people here do careful, honest work because they take pride in it, not because someone is standing over them.



You will be measured. Response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction — reviewed with you weekly for the first month, then monthly. You'll always know where you stand. You will never be surprised by feedback.



What you'll actually do



- Answer customer
s, live chat, phone calls, and social media DMs/comments

- Look up and process orders in Shopify; track shipments; proactively update customers when something is late

- Issue refunds, handle returns and warranty claims, and de-escalate complaints

- Keep customer and order records accurate — including logging issues we should fix upstream

- Answer product questions and make simple recommendations

- Flag patterns: if five people ask the same question this week, we want to hear about it



What we need from you



- Based in the Philippines, working from a quiet space with fiber internet (25 Mbps+ real speed, not advertised speed)

- This is your only job. Not your main job — your only one. We pay a fair full-time rate, on time, and treat this as a real career, so that's a reasonable ask

- Hands-on Shopify admin experience. Not "familiar with." You should be able to find a partial refund option without a tutorial

- At least 1 year in e-commerce or BPO customer support, ideally for a US or Canadian brand

- Excellent written English — this is most of the job. Your writing should sound like a warm, competent human, not a template

- Comfortable on the phone with North American customers

- A backup plan for power and internet. A UPS or power bank plus a mobile data plan is the minimum — this is your responsibility to have in place

- Willing to provide two references we can actually call, including a direct supervisor

- When you apply, the first word of your
 subject line must be BLUEBERRY.



What we offer

- $5–7 USD/hour depending on experience, paid every two weeks via Wise, on time, without exception

- Paid training during your first two weeks

- 13th month pay

- 5 days paid time off per year after your first year

- Reviewed for a raise at 6 months and annually after that — good work gets paid for, you won't have to ask

- A defined role with written processes, not a chaotic "wear all the hats" situation



How to apply

- Follow every instruction in this post — including the one that isn't in this section. We use this as our first filter, and most applications are eliminated here.



Send us:

1. Your resume and two references (name, role, company, and a working phone or WhatsApp number for each — we do call them).

2. A short written test. Below is a real customer message. Write the reply you'd send, in 150 words or less, plus two sentences on what you'd check in Shopify before sending it.



"This is the THIRD time I'm writing. I ordered on the 4th, tracking hasn't moved in 9 days, and nobody has answered me. I needed this for a gift that was LAST WEEKEND. I want a refund and I want to know why nobody bothered to respond. Honestly considering just doing a chargeback."



Write this yourself. We compare your writing to how you speak on video, and we can tell when they don't match. A real, human, slightly imperfect answer beats a polished AI one every time.



3. Your preferred working hours, in EST

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

5. A video (Loom or Google Drive, sharing enabled — test the link before you send it). Unedited, one take, 5 minutes or less. Applications without a video are not reviewed.



Video questions:

- Show us your workspace on camera right now. Run a live internet speed test on screen, and walk us through exactly what you do when the power goes out mid-shift.

- Tell us one thing about Shopify that most support agents get wrong. Be as specific and technical as you like.

- Describe a time you made a real mistake with a customer. What happened, what did it cost, and what did you change afterward? "I'm a perfectionist" answers get skipped.

- Of every job you've had, which one did you do your best work at — and what about it made that possible?

- What's the part of this job you think you'd struggle with most?



What happens next



1. We review applications and reply to everyone who followed the instructions

2. Short interview call

3. Reference calls

4. Paid 2-week trial at full rate, real work, real feedback

5. Permanent offer

title: Executive Assistant
description:
**Executive Assistant — Full Operational Support (Multi-Company)**



We're hiring a versatile executive assistant to support the founder across Vantage Point Agency and several other ventures. This is an all-in-one role for someone who can juggle multiple businesses, stay organized under fast-moving priorities, and take work off the founder's plate without needing hand-holding.



**What you'll do**



Manage and respond to
 across multiple inboxes, flagging what matters and handling the rest. Set and confirm appointments, coordinate calendars, and keep the schedule tight across all companies. Take clear notes during calls and meetings, then turn them into action items and follow-ups. Plan and organize the founder's day, week, and projects, keeping deadlines and deliverables on track. Handle customer support by answering questions, resolving issues, and keeping clients happy across every business. Keep files, systems, and workflows organized so nothing slips through the cracks.



**Must have**



Hands-on experience with CRMs, comfortable navigating pipelines, contacts, and automations. Working knowledge of AI tools and how to use them to move faster. Excellent English, written and spoken, clear, professional, and error-free. Strong work ethic where you show up, take ownership, and get things done. Looking to grow with the team long term, not just fill a short-term gap.



**Who you are**



Highly organized and detail-oriented, someone who catches what others miss. Comfortable switching between different companies and priorities in the same day. Self-directed and able to move things forward without constant direction. Reliable, discreet, and trustworthy with sensitive information. Quick to learn new tools and systems.



This role is central to how the founder operates. If you're a hard worker who thrives on keeping many plates spinning and wants a long-term seat on a growing team, we want to hear from you.



Want me to add compensation, hours, or remote/location details?

title: Senior Wholesale Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist | $12/hr + Bonus | Long-Term Role
description:
Elk Homes, LLC is a Pennsylvania-licensed real estate wholesale investment company. We have been outsourcing through online platforms since 2011. Our employer feedback rating across 90+ hires is 4.79 stars.

We are hiring one Senior Wholesale Acquisitions Specialist for a long-term role on our team. This is a 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday position. The work is real, the targets are clear, and we pay above the platfor
dian because we want senior people who can do the job.



The Role 



You will work signed wholesale leads in Montgomery County and Bucks County, Pennsylvania. Each day you will dial approximately 100 motivated sellers, qualify with BANT, run comps using Bright MLS, calculate offers using the standard wholesale formula (ARV × 0.70 minus repairs minus $15,000 = MAO), present offers, negotiate, and close contracts in DocuSign. All activity is logged in real time in Follow Up Boss.



Daily Responsibilities 



Lead Management Responsibilities:



• Proactively follow up on existing leads, determine category (motivated seller, cash buyer, both, neither), and build the relationship

• Take detailed notes on every interaction; offer insight on how to progress each seller or buyer to the next step

• Track down phone numbers for hard-to-find sellers using skip-tracing tools and public records

• Analyze the nuances involved in identifying high-value sellers and qualified cash buyers

• Manage every lead through daily Follow Up Boss updates; stay on each lead until the deal closes or the lead is killed

• Tag leads appropriately per company tagging convention

• Create follow-up tasks on the team calendar in Follow Up Boss and Smarter Contact

• Engage prospects and clients to establish rapport, address objections, and close the deal

• Organize and push leads from Smarter Contact into Follow Up Boss daily, preferably in real time



Growth Deal Acquisition Tasks: 



You will need to do what AI and robots cannot — apply critical thought, run high-value analyses, and build personalized plans for each incoming lead.



• Evaluate comparable sales, property value, and property condition through research, outreach, data analysis, and market trend examination

• Coordinate site visits with the Broker or local agents (VA does not personally inspect properties)

• Coordinate rehab bid requests through Investor Boss and confirm ARV to validate deal viability

• Negotiate offers and sale prices

• Renegotiate contracts for lower prices when conditions warrant

• Prepare agreements of sale and submit to the Broker for approval



Qualities We Hire For



•  Positive & Outgoing

•  Hardworking and Trustworthy

•  Calm & Able to deal with intense deals

•  Friendly and Personable

•  Organized with great Time Management

•  Proactive. Driven towards action, not reaction.

•  Critical Mindset & Empathy

•  Persuasive. Able to convince others.

•  Bottom-line oriented

• Pragmatic, results-oriented

• Adaptive. Not rigid, able to adjust.

• Respectful of authority and direction



Compensation



• $12.00 USD per hour, weekly cap $480

• $100 bonus per signed contract that closes

• 13th-month pay in December (prorated for first year)

• Building PTO: 5 days year one, 10 days year two, 15 days year three

• Weekly pay for the first 8 weeks via Payoneer, then biweekly



???? Required Experience



• Minimum 1 year of US wholesale real estate acquisitions experience

• Native-fluent English, both spoken and written

• Experience with Follow Up Boss (or another major real estate CRM)

• Experience with a major dialer (Dialpad or RingCentral preferred)

• Comfort with paid recorded calls and daily KPI reporting



???? Required Tools (Provided by Employer)



Follow Up Boss, Dialpad (or RingCentral), DocuSign, Bright MLS access, Duo Mobile authenticator. You may not use a personal phone, WhatsApp, or any off-system communication for business purposes. All calls are made through the company-provided dialer. All leads are entered in Follow Up Boss in real time.

The phone system is locked at hire (Dialpad or RingCentral, whichever the Broker provides). The VA may not request a change to a third system after hire. Phone-system-shopping is a fraud red flag.



Required Equipment (You Provide)



• Reliable laptop with 8GB+ RAM

• Wired Ethernet internet, minimum 25 Mbps

• Professional USB headset

• Quiet, private workspace

• Backup internet and electricity

• Smartphone for 2FA



How We Train and Manage



We do not throw new hires into the deep end. Your first week is paid training and onboarding with screen-recorded walkthroughs. You will have direct access to me (the Broker of Record) by message and weekly Zoom from Day 8 forward. I review one of your calls every day in your first 60 days and send you a voice memo with feedback. This is the fastest way I know to make a new acquisitions VA into a great one.



How to Apply



Start your application with the phrase “Hi Lori, Bavaro Beach” so I know you read this post carefully. Then answer these four questions:



1. How many years of wholesale acquisitions experience do you have, and at which companies?

2. What dialer and CRM did you use most recently?

3. What was your average dial-to-contract ratio per week?

4. What is your hourly rate expectation, and are you available full-time 9-5 EST?



What Happens Next



After applications close, we run a written
 interview (no
 until later). Finalists complete a paid 3-day trial ($80 USD, 20 leads, real work). The trial winner is hired for a 5-month probationary period.

This is a long-term seat. We are not looking for someone who will be here for 90 days and then be gone. If you have the experience and you want a stable home with a calm, professional Broker, apply.

title: Graphics Designer - Native & Direct Response (Ecommerce)
description:
Design that doesn't just look good. Design that converts.

Department:  Creative

Type:  Full-Time | Remote

Reports To:  Creative Director / Head of Marketing

Compensation:  Competitive Base 

Location:  Worldwide | Remote





THIS ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

You are a direct response designer who understands that every pixel exists to move a person from curiosity to click to conversion — and you can prove it with your portfolio.

If your portfolio is full of logos, brand guides, and organic social content — this role isn't a fit. If your portfolio shows landing pages, advertorials, native thumbnails, and funnel visuals with actual performance results behind them — keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DESIGNING

Your primary outputs will be:

Advertorial-style landing page graphics that guide readers toward conversion through visual storytelling

Native ad thumbnails and images designed to blend into editorial environments on Taboola and Outbrain

Hook visuals that create curiosity gaps without looking spammy — subtle, editorial, and psychologically sharp

Mechanism explanation graphics — infographic-style visuals that make a product's value instantly credible

Before/after storytelling sequences embedded into long-form advertorial pages

Authority-style imagery — social proof visuals, credential callouts, and trust-building design elements

Multiple angle variations per offer — you'll never design just one version of anything

GIFs and light motion creatives for click-through rate lift where platforms allow

Product mockups for use across paid and organic channels



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design landing page and sales page creatives as your primary, daily output

Build static native ad images and thumbnail variants optimized for editorial-feed CTR

Develop multiple hook and angle variations for every campaign to enable rigorous A/B testing

Work directly with media buyers to iterate on creative based on live performance data

Optimize designs for both CTR (at the ad level) and CVR (at the landing page level) — you understand both metrics and how your work impacts each

Maintain visual consistency across multiple brands while adapting tone and style for each

Stay compliant: you understand platform policies and health/wellness claim sensitivity — you push conversion without pushing boundaries

Ship fast. Give feedback loops real turnaround times — this is a high-output, test-and-iterate environment



WHO YOU ARE

2–5 years of graphic design experience specifically in direct response, performance marketing, or paid traffic creative

You've designed for native platforms — you know what an advertorial looks like and how a Taboola thumbnail needs to feel to get the click

You think like a media buyer: CTR, CVR, hook rate, thumb-stop — these are not foreign terms, they're how you evaluate your own work

You can take a raw marketing brief and produce 3–5 distinct creative angles without hand-holding

You work fast and iterate faster — you're not precious about your work, you're precious about your results

You understand the psychology of native advertising: editorial blending, curiosity gaps, and the visual triggers that drive clicks

You can balance platform compliance with conversion — you know where the line is and how to get close without crossing it

Portfolio showcases landing pages, advertorial graphics, and native ad creatives — not just brand decks and social posts



TOOLS & SKILLS REQUIRED

Figma — primary design and collaboration tool

Adobe Photoshop — image manipulation, compositing, and retouching

Adobe After Effects or equivalent — for GIF and light motion creative production

Understanding of native ad specs across Taboola, Outbrain, and MGID

Ability to work from a written brief and produce production-ready assets without excessive revision cycles

Strong plus: Experience designing compliance-friendly creatives for health, wellness, and gifting verticals. You know the difference between 'clinically proven' (no-go) and 'thousands of customers report...' (workable).



DO NOT APPLY IF

Portfolio is mandatory. Applications without direct response or performance marketing examples will not be reviewed — no exceptions.



Share 3-5 landing pages or advertorials you designed for paid traffic.

Share 3-5 ad creatives you've designed and has scaled or performed well



You only have brand, social, or agency portfolio work with no DTC or paid traffic context

You've never worked alongside a media buyer or received performance data as creative feedback

You don't know what CTR or CVR means in the context of your own designs

You need significant creative direction to produce one concept — we need someone who produces five

You can't show a landing page, advertorial graphic, or native thumbnail in your portfolio



WHY JOIN US

See your creative work directly tied to revenue — real attribution, real feedback, real growth

Work with experienced media buyers who give you performance data on every creative you ship

Fast creative cycles — your work goes live quickly and improves based on real data, not opinions

Performance bonuses tied to creative output quality and campaign contribution

Career growth into Senior Designer or Creative Strategist as we scale

Remote-first, high-ownership culture — you own your output and your craft

Work across multiple consumer brands in gifting, health, wellness, and lifestyle



Ready to show us what you've got?  Apply with your portfolio link (required), a brief note on your experience with native advertising, and one example of a creative you designed where you know the CTR or CVR it achieved. We want to see how you measure your own work.



APPLY HERE: 

Dont forget to:

Share 3-5 landing pages or advertorials you designed for paid traffic.

Share 3-5 ad creatives you've designed and has scaled or performed well

title: Outbound Sales Representative/Telemarketer
description:
About the Role:



We are looking for a confident, persuasive, and results-driven Outbound Sales Representative to contact prospective and existing leads, introduce our toy products, identify purchasing needs, and convert conversations into sales.

 

This is a phone-based sales position for someone who is comfortable making outbound calls, following up consistently, handling objections, and asking for the sale. You will be responsible for maintaining professional communication with leads throughout the sales process, from the initial introduction through order confirmation and follow-up.

 

This is not a customer service-only position. The successful candidate must be proactive, comfortable working toward sales targets, and able to move conversations forward without waiting for constant supervision.



Key Responsibilities:



• Make outbound calls to prospective, previous, and existing customers.

• Introduce and explain available toy products, promotions, and product options.

 • Identify each lead's business needs, interests, purchasing timeline, and budget.

• Recommend suitable products based on the customer's requirements.

• Follow up with leads through phone calls,
, text, or other approved communication channels.

• Build rapport with potential customers and maintain professional relationships.

• Respond to questions regarding products, pricing, availability, ordering, and delivery.

• Handle common sales objections confidently and professionally.

• Encourage qualified leads to place an order or proceed to the next step.

• Reconnect with inactive customers and identify repeat-order opportunities.

• Maintain accurate records of calls, lead status, conversations, follow-ups, and outcomes.

• Update the company's CRM, spreadsheet, or sales tracking system consistently.

• Coordinate with the internal team regarding product availability, quotations, orders, and customer concerns.

• Meet assigned activity and sales targets.

• Provide regular reports on calls completed, leads contacted, follow-ups scheduled, and sales closed.

• Learn the company's products, pricing, customer types, and sales process.

• Perform other reasonable sales-related tasks as assigned.



Performance Expectations / Performance may be measured based on:



• Number of outbound calls completed

• Number of leads successfully contacted

• Quality of lead conversations

• Follow-up completion rate

• Number of qualified opportunities generated

• Quotes or orders requested

• Sales conversion rate

• Revenue or orders generated

• Accuracy of CRM and sales records

• Attendance, reliability, and schedule adherence



Qualifications:



• Previous experience in telemarketing, outbound sales, appointment setting, lead generation, or phone-based customer acquisition.

• Strong spoken and written English.

• Confident and professional phone presence.

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

• Able to communicate clearly without sounding overly scripted.

• Strong listening, questioning, and objection-handling skills.

• Persistent and consistent without becoming aggressive or unprofessional.

• Comfortable discussing products, pricing, and purchasing decisions.

•Organized and able to manage multiple leads and follow-up schedules.

• Able to work independently and remain productive with minimal supervision.

• Willing to receive coaching, follow sales processes, and improve based on feedback.

• Experience using a CRM, dialer, Google Sheets,
, or similar sales tools is preferred.

• Experience selling physical products, wholesale products, retail supplies, toys, or business-to-business products is an advantage but not required.



Technical Requirements Applicants must have:



• A reliable computer or laptop

• Stable high-speed internet connection

• A professional headset with a clear microphone

• A quiet and distraction-free workspace

• Backup internet or a reasonable contingency plan for outages

• Availability to work during assigned US Pacific Time hours

• Ability to use online communication, calling, and sales-tracking tools



Ideal Candidate / The ideal candidate is someone who:

 

• Enjoys speaking with people and building rapport

• Is naturally persuasive but still respectful

• Does not become discouraged by rejection

• Understands that consistent follow-up is part of sales

• Can confidently guide a conversation toward a decision

• Takes ownership of assigned leads

• Keeps accurate records without needing repeated reminders

• Is dependable, coachable, and motivated by measurable results

• Knows when to continue nurturing a lead and when to ask directly for the sale



Compensation:



The monthly compensation for this full-time role is USD $500-$600, based on relevant experience, communication skills, sales ability, and overall qualifications.

 

The position follows a schedule aligned with US Pacific Time, including adjustments between PST and PDT.



Application Requirements:

Our hiring timeline is tight and we will not be able to open and read messages here in Onlinejobs one by one. To be considered, please answer a few questions in the form here: 



*We don't entertain candidates who will not fill in the google form.

title: Process Improvement and Operations Project Manager for Medical Practice
description:
OptiMindHealth is a mental health and wellness counseling company. We are a group of doctors, psychologists, and clinical social workers committed to improving the psychological health and wellbeing of our patients. We are supported by a hard-working and devoted staff who help us in all aspects of practice operations.



We are seeking a Process Improvement & Operations Project Manager to join our Quality and Compliance division. This role is perfect for someone experienced in operations management, workflow optimization, data analysis, and continuous improvement.



If you enjoy building better systems, solving operational challenges, and helping teams work more efficiently and accurately, this role is for you.



Position Overview:

You will strengthen organizational performance through project management, data-driven decision making, process optimization, and the development of clear, effective protocols. Your work will directly reduce errors, streamline operations, and improve compliance across the company.



Core Responsibilities



1. Operational Project Management

- Lead or support cross functional projects that enhance efficiency and compliance.

- Plan, scope, and manage improvement initiatives from start to finish.

- Track milestones, manage risks, and report progress to leadership.



2. Process Improvement and Root Cause Analysis

- Evaluate current workflows to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies.

- Conduct root cause analysis to uncover underlying issues.

- Implement improvement strategies that create long term operational solutions.



3. Protocol Development

- Review outdated or unclear procedures and identify knowledge gaps.

- Write, revise, and update SOPs and workflow documents for clarity and consistency.

- Partner with department leaders to design workflows that support growth and service excellence.



4. Data Analysis & Reporting

- Collect and analyze operational data to identify trends and performance issues.

- Create reports and visual dashboards to support decision making.

- Use data insights to recommend improvements and measure results.



5. Training & Staff Development

- Develop and deliver training for new or updated workflows.

- Provide coaching to ensure consistent adoption of procedures.

- Collaborate with leadership to assess training needs tied to process improvements.



6. Audit & I
 Management

- Conduct targeted audits to ensure workflow accuracy and compliance.

- Lead i
 investigations, document findings, and recommend corrective actions.

- Use audit results to drive organizational improvements.



This role is ideal for professionals who:

- Have hands on experience in operations management, workflow design, or process improvement.

- Enjoy solving problems at the system level, not the individual level.

- Have strong technical writing skills and can translate complex processes into clear protocols.

- Are analytical thinkers who use data to drive decisions.

- Are proactive project managers with the ability to lead initiatives from concept to completion.

- Want to make a meaningful impact on organizational efficiency, quality, and patient experience.



Salary and Work Setup:

The position is a permanent work from home arrangement, with additional details below.



1. Base Salary: 55,000 PHP Monthly

2. Commission-Based: No

3. Payment Method: Twice Per Month

4. Work Schedule: US Business Hours; Full-Time; 40 hours per week (No part-time)



Benefits Package:

Working at OptiMindHealth provides a stable work environment for staff members who excel and grow in their careers. Our benefits package includes:



1. Government-mandated benefits (SSS, Pag-Ibig, PHIC)

2. 13th Month Pay

3. HMO Coverage

4. Ten days of vacation per year

5. Five days of sick leave allowed per year

6. Philippine holidays observed

s.

title: Freelance Excel & Product Design Specialist — Home Design Specification Packages
description:
I am looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented freelancer to help develop a professional home design specification package for builders, renovators, and homeowners.



I will provide the design selections and product specifications. Your role will be to organize this information into an intuitive, visually appealing system that is easy for clients and builders to understand and use.



The finished product will combine a comprehensive Excel specification workbook with a polished two-page marketing document. We will begin with one project, with the opportunity for ongoing work as additional home packages are developed.



Scope of Work

1. Home Specification Workbook



Create a professionally designed Excel workbook containing all design selections and specifications for a home. The workbook should:



Organize information clearly by room and category

Be intuitive and easy to navigate

Include product names, manufacturers, colours, finishes and model numbers

Include clickable links to products and suppliers

Include product photographs or reference images

Show individual product costs and estimated totals

Track room-level and overall budgets

Allow products and costs to be updated efficiently

Use formulas, filters, dropdown menus and other helpful Excel functions where appropriate

Maintain a consistent and professional visual style throughout

Be suitable for use by homeowners, builders, trades and purchasing teams



Typical categories may include:



Flooring

Tile and stone

Plumbing fixtures

Lighting

Cabinetry and millwork

Countertops

Appliances

Paint and wall finishes

Doors and hardware

Furniture and accessories

Exterior finishes

Landscaping selections

2. Two-Page Marketing and Sales Document



Create a polished, visually appealing two-page document that can be used to market and sell the home design package online.



The sales document should clearly communicate:



What is included in the package

Who the package is designed for

The design aesthetic and overall vision

The approximate construction or finishing budget

How the package helps clients save time, control costs and make coordinated design decisions

Key features and benefits

Representative images from the package

A clear call to action



The document should feel elevated, modern and appropriate for the home design and construction industry.



3. Document Protection and Digital Delivery



Research and recommend a practical method for protecting the digital product. The goal is to limit unauthorized copying and sharing and, if technically feasible, restrict access to one purchaser or one registered computer.



Because standard Excel password protection does not provide true one-computer licensing, experience with digital rights management, licence-key systems, protected download platforms or secure client portals would be a strong asset.



Deliverables



The initial project will include:



One complete and fully formatted Excel home specification workbook

A clear room-by-room and category-based organizational structure

Product links, pricing, photographs and budget calculations

One professionally designed two-page marketing document

Editable source files and final client-ready versions

A recommended solution for licensing, protecting and delivering the digital files

A reusable framework that can be adapted for future home packages

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate will have:



Strong Excel skills, including formulas, formatting, filters, dropdowns and workbook organization

Exceptional attention to detail

Experience creating polished, client-facing spreadsheets

Graphic design, document design or presentation-design experience

An excellent sense of visual hierarchy, spacing, typography and layout

The ability to organize a large amount of information clearly

Experience with construction specifications, interior design, architecture or home building

Experience creating digital products for online sale

Familiarity with file protection, licensing or digital rights management

Strong written communication and the ability to work collaboratively

Availability for additional projects if the first package is successful

Project Structure



This will begin as a paid freelance project involving one home design package which will take 1 month. If the process and finished product are successful, there will be opportunities to create additional packages in a variety of aesthetics and budget ranges.



How to Apply



Please include:



A brief description of your relevant experience

Examples of sophisticated Excel workbooks you have created

Examples of marketing documents, sales sheets or other visually designed materials

Any experience working with home builders, interior designers, architects or construction specifications

Your recommended approach to securely delivering and protecting the files





Please begin your application with the words “Home Specification Package” so I know you have read the complete description.

title: Paid Media Manager / Analytics Expert
description:
Job Scorecard — Paid Media Manager



Mission

The purpose of this role is to run and scale paid media across our client accounts (typically $500K–$5M/month in ad spend) — hitting efficient cost-per-purchase and LTV:CAC targets, scaling budget without losing efficiency, and giving clients clear visibility into what's working and why.



Outcomes

Efficient Acquisition — KPI is Cost Per Purchase / CAC, measured via platform data plus an attribution tool, targeting meets-or-beats the client-specific CAC target, reviewed weekly.

Profitable Scaling — KPI is LTV:CAC ratio, measured via client data plus attribution tool, targeting 3:1 minimum and 4:1+ preferred blended, reviewed monthly.

Budget Pacing — KPI is spend vs. planned budget, measured via platform dashboards, targeting 100% of planned spend deployed with no under- or over-pacing, reviewed weekly.

Creative Velocity — KPI is new creative tested, measured via Ads Manager or a testing tracker, targeting fresh creative in rotation every week with no stale-ad fatigue, reviewed weekly.

Client Communication — KPI is reporting delivered, measured via ClickUp or a client reporting doc, targeting one performance report per client per week, on time, reviewed weekly.



Key Responsibilities



Channel Budget Allocation: Set and adjust spend splits across Meta, Google, and TikTok (and any test channels) based on real performance data, not a fixed formula.

Campaign Optimization: Monitor and optimize live campaigns daily — bids, audiences, placements, exclusions — to protect CAC as spend scales.

Creative Testing: Run a consistent testing cadence for new ad concepts/hooks; kill underperformers fast, scale winners deliberately.

Attribution & Reporting: Track cost-per-purchase, ROAS, and LTV:CAC per channel and per client; flag when a channel or campaign is bleeding money before it becomes a bigger problem.

Scaling Discipline: Know the difference between healthy scaling and just throwing more budget at diminishing returns.

Client Communication: Explain performance and recommendations in plain language — clients need to understand the "why," not just see a dashboard.

Self-Sufficiency: Operate independently day-to-day; flag issues or budget risks rather than needing routine oversight or approval.



Key Competencies



Platform Fluency: Deep hands-on experience in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads at minimum; TikTok Ads Manager a strong plus.

Numbers Literacy: Comfortable with CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, contribution margin — not just revenue-level metrics.

Judgment Under Ambiguity: Can read performance data and make a scaling/cutting call without waiting to be told what to do.

Creative Testing Rigor: Understands ad fatigue, frequency, and why testing velocity matters more than any single "perfect" ad.

Client-Facing Communication: Can translate performance data into a clear, non-jargon explanation for a client.

Autonomy: Can manage day-to-day budget and optimization decisions without needing regular check-ins or approvals.



Tools Used

Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, an attribution/analytics tool (e.g. Triple Whale, Northbeam, or platform-native), Google Sheets/Excel, ClickUp (reporting & task management), Slack (client + team communication).

Job Description

Who We're Looking For

A Paid Media Manager who's actually run ecommerce ad accounts at meaningful spend — not just managed a small budget for one brand. You should have real opinions on channel mix, CAC targets, and where money gets wasted, backed by actual experience, not theory.

Full-Time Only: This is a full-time role (40 hrs/week). We are not considering candidates who are part-time or who work other clients on the side.

Remote Position: Fully remote.

Qualities: Sharp with numbers, decisive, self-sufficient, and able to explain your reasoning clearly to a client who isn't a media buyer themselves.

A Note on AI Use in This Application: Don't use Claude or any other AI tool to answer the screening questions below — we want your actual answers, not AI's. If it looks AI-written, you're out.



Responsibilities



Set and adjust channel budget splits across Meta, Google, TikTok (and test channels) based on live performance.

Optimize active campaigns daily to protect and improve cost-per-purchase as spend scales.

Run ongoing creative testing and know when to kill vs. scale a concept.

Track and report CAC, ROAS, and LTV:CAC per channel and per client, weekly.

Flag underperforming spend or budget risk before it compounds.

Communicate performance and recommendations to clients in plain language.

Work independently; flag issues as they come up rather than waiting for review.



Experience



Proven experience managing paid media for ecommerce accounts at $500K+/month in spend.

Track record of hitting or improving CAC and LTV:CAC targets — be ready to talk numbers, not just describe process.

Deep hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads; TikTok Ads Manager a plus.

Experience with an attribution/analytics tool (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar).

Comfortable presenting performance data directly to clients.



How We Will Help You Succeed



Established client relationships and account history to build from.

Clear reporting cadence so feedback happens weekly, not through constant oversight.

Access to creative production (video editing, design) so you're not blocked waiting on assets.

Room to make real budget and strategy calls — this isn't a "follow the playbook" role.



Time Expectations

This is a full-time role, 40 hours/week, broken down as:



Campaign monitoring & optimization (all channels) — ongoing, daily, highest priority — ~15 hrs/week

Budget allocation & pacing review — ~5 hrs/week

Creative testing setup & review — ~8 hrs/week

Attribution & performance reporting — ~6 hrs/week

Client communication — ~6 hrs/week



That totals 40 hrs/week.



Interview / Screening Questions

Note to Candidates: Answer these in your own words — no Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI. We can tell, and it'll disqualify you.



If you were handed a $1M/month ecommerce ad account today, how would you split budget across channels, and why? Where have you personally seen the most efficient cost-per-purchase across accounts you've run?

What LTV:CAC ratio do you consider healthy for ecommerce, and where have you actually seen accounts losing money vs. making money — be specific, not theoretical.

Walk me through a time you had to d
 whether to keep scaling a campaign or pull back. What data told you which way to go?

How do you approach creative testing — cadence, what you test for, when you kill an ad vs. let it keep running?

Describe a time a client pushed back on your recommendation. How did you handle it?

What's your process for catching a campaign that's quietly bleeding money before it shows up as a big problem in the monthly report?

Which attribution/analytics tools have you used, and how do you handle disagreements between platform-reported ROAS and what the attribution tool says?

Can you confirm you're available full-time and not currently juggling other clients or part-time work?

Tell me about the largest monthly ad spend account you've personally managed, and what your CAC/LTV results looked like.

How do you prefer to receive feedback — frequent check-ins, or comfortable working with occasional (weekly or bi-weekly) reviews?

title: AI Video Ad Expert (Conversion focused on META Ads)
description:
About Us



We're a direct-response marketing company producing high-volume video ad creative for performance campaigns on Meta 
 + Instagram). Our ads are built to convert, not to win awards. We test aggressively, iterate fast, and scale what works. We're looking for someone who can turn scripts and creative briefs into scroll-stopping, AI-generated video ads at speed.(AI UGC, AI Podcasts etc)



The Role



You'll be our go-to for producing AI-generated video ad creative — UGC-style talking-head ads, b-roll-driven ads, AI Podcats, AI Skits, AI Street Interviews and hybrid formats — optimized specifically for Meta's feed and Reels placements. You'll work from our scripts, hooks, and shot lists (we handle the copy and strategy), and your job is to bring them to life with AI video tools in a way that feels native, authentic, and drives clicks and conversions.



This is not a "make it look cinematic" role. This is a "make it perform" role. You should be obsessed with hook rate, hold rate, and CTR and understand how creative decisions in the first 3 seconds make or break an ad along with realism.



What You'll Do

-Produce AI-generated video ads (See above for formats) from our scripts and creative briefs

-Generate multiple hook variations per concept for A/B testing (same body, different openers)

- Ensure realism with voice as well - no robot voices

-Turn around new creative and iterations quickly — speed matters as much as quality

-Suggest creative improvements based on what's performing (we share performance data)

-Keep creative within platform compliance guidelines (we'll brief you — experience in regulated verticals like insurance, health, or finance is a big plus)



Must-Have Skills

-Proven experience producing direct-response video ads for Meta — you can show us ads you've made and speak to how they performed

-Fluency with current AI video tools (e.g., HIggsfield, Omni, HeyGen, or similar) — you know which tool fits which job and stay on top of new releases

-AI voiceover proficiency (ElevenLabs or similar) with an ear for natural, non-robotic delivery

-Understanding of DR creative principles: hooks, open loops, pattern interrupts, native-feeling UGC aesthetics

-Ability to make AI avatars/footage feel human — you know the difference between "obviously AI" and "scroll-stopping"





What Success Looks Like

-You consistently deliver ad-ready creative that requires minimal revision

-Your hook variations give us real signal in testing — meaningful differences, not cosmetic ones

-Turnaround time from brief to first draft is measured in days, not weeks

-Our cost-per-acquisition improves because the creative is doing its job



How to Apply



Send us:



-3–5 examples of AI-generated video ads you've produced (links or files) — ideally with any performance context you can share

-Your rates and typical turnaround time for a 30–60 second UGC-style ad with 3 hook variants

title: AI Lifestyle Imagery Designer
description:
About THOR Kitchen

THOR Kitchen designs professional-grade appliances built for those who take their kitchen and outdoor living seriously. From powerful gas ranges to sleek refrigeration and outdoor grills, our products are engineered to perform — and our marketing brings that standard to life visually. We're growing our creative team and looking for a designer who can help us show the world what life looks like with THOR in it.

The Role

We're looking for a creative visual designer with a strong command of AI image generation tools to join our marketing team. In this role, you'll take our existing product renders and photography and composite them into aspirational, on-brand lifestyle scenes — kitchens, outdoor entertaining spaces, modern homes — that make our appliances the hero of the shot.

This is a hands-on production role that sits at the intersection of design craft and emerging AI tooling. If you love experimenting with tools like Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or Stable Diffusion and have a designer's eye for light, composition, and realism, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

•Use AI image generation and compositing platforms (Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, etc.) to create lifestyle imagery featuring THOR appliances

•Composite official THOR product renders and photography into AI-generated scenes with realistic lighting, perspective, and environmental context

•Develop a consistent visual language across kitchen, outdoor, and entertaining settings that aligns with the THOR brand

•Produce image assets for use across
 campaigns, social media, website, paid advertising, and print collateral

•Collaborate with the marketing team to interpret creative briefs and translate campaign themes into compelling visuals

•Iterate quickly on concepts, presenting options and incorporating feedback efficiently

•Stay current on AI image generation developments and surface new tools or techniques that could benefit the team

•Maintain organized file libraries of final assets, source renders, and reusable scene components

What You Bring

•3+ years of professional design experience, with a strong portfolio of lifestyle, product, or commercial imagery

•Demonstrated, hands-on experience with AI image generation platforms — not just familiarity, but actual production work

•Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Firefly's Generative Fill for compositing real product photography into generated scenes

•A sharp eye for photorealism: lighting direction, shadow consistency, scale, material rendering, and perspective

•Ability to work from product renders and brand assets rather than starting from scratch

•Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with marketing, creative, and digital teams

•Self-directed work style with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

Nice to Have

•Experience in the appliance, home goods, or premium consumer products space

•Background in architectural visualization, interior design photography, or food/lifestyle photography

•Familiarity with Midjourney's advanced prompting techniques, ControlNet, or similar compositing workflows

•Motion or video editing skills for social content

title: Fitness Brand Partnerships Executive — Base Pay + 10% Commission
description:

This is a performance-led sales role, not a general virtual assistant position. Your primary objective will be to generate revenue by securing paid brand partnerships, UGC campaigns, sponsorships, affiliate opportunities and long-term commercial relationships.



You will receive a small guaranteed base salary, but the main earning opportunity comes from the partnerships you personally acquire.



What success looks like



Success in this position means:



Securing paid partnerships for JKFITT.

Building relationships with relevant brand decision-makers.

Moving prospects from initial outreach to a confirmed commercial agreement.

Creating a reliable pipeline of new partnership opportunities.

Generating more revenue than the cost of the position.



Sending large numbers of generic
s without producing qualified conversations or commercial opportunities will not be considered successful performance.



Responsibilities

Research suitable sportswear, boxing, calisthenics, fitness technology, recovery, nutrition and wellness brands.

Identify partnership managers, influencer marketing managers, brand managers and other relevant decision-makers.

Contact brands through
, LinkedIn, Instagram and creator application programmes.

Write personalised pitches based on each company’s products and current campaigns.

Present JKFITT’s physique, content quality, audience growth and visual impact as commercially valuable assets.

Follow up consistently and professionally with prospects.

Qualify partnership opportunities and determine each brand’s budget, campaign needs and timeline.

Help prepare partnership proposals, media information and campaign concepts.

Move interested brands towards a confirmed paid agreement.

Maintain a clear CRM or spreadsheet containing contacts, messages, replies, follow-ups, deal values and outcomes.

Provide a concise weekly report showing outreach, conversations, proposals and revenue secured.



Final pricing, contracts and partnership approval will remain with the founder, but you will be expected to take ownership of the acquisition process.



Compensation

$150 monthly guaranteed base salary.

Approximately 8–10 flexible hours per week.

10% commission on the initial payment received from every paid partnership you directly source and help close.

Commission is uncapped.



For example:



Secure a $500 campaign and earn $50 commission.

Secure a $1,500 campaign and earn $150 commission.

Secure a $3,000 partnership and earn $300 commission.

Secure $10,000 in partnership revenue and earn $1,000 commission.

Writes persuasive and professional English.

I CLOSE PARTNERSHIPS

We've grown quickly into a seven-figure run rate, and our goal by the end of 2026 is to be the most trusted name in Local SEO for service businesses in our markets.



Two things that make us different. First, we treat content like paid media: everything is a test, everything gets measured, and formats earn their place with data. Second, we build our own internal tools. Every department at OPT runs on custom dashboards and automations built in-house, and you'll help design the ones that make your job easier.



Why this role exists



We're recording a large volume of short-form content with our founder on camera and an in-house videographer and editing team behind it. What's missing is the operator in the middle: the person who takes a topic from idea to script to shoot to edit to published post to performance review, and keeps that flywheel spinning every single week without anything stalling.



The raw materials are all here: a founder with a proven track record on camera, production capacity, an editing team, and a clear offer that converts. Your job is to turn those pieces into a content engine that grows our audience and feeds our sales pipeline.



What you'll own



1. Scripts and formats. Write and co-write short-form scripts with the founder. Develop hooks that stop the scroll and structures that hold retention. Research what's working in our niche and adjacent ones, and bring format ideas to the table. You're expected to have opinions, backed by examples.



2. The production pipeline. Plan and coordinate recording sessions so shoot days are efficient and nothing gets filmed without a purpose. Brief the editing team clearly, manage revisions, and keep the pipeline moving from raw footage to publish-ready content on a consistent rhythm.



3. Publishing and testing. Schedule and post across Instagram,
, YouTube Shorts, and other relevant platforms. Run structured split tests on topics, hooks, and formats. Manage the accounts day to day: captions, packaging, and the details that d
 whether a good video performs or dies.



4. The data. Track performance across platforms and present it clearly: what's growing, what's converting, and what we should double down on or kill. Views are the input. The metric that matters is qualified leads and booked calls coming from content, and you connect the two.



5. The tools. Work with the founder to build the internal dashboards and automations that remove the grind from your role, including content calendars, performance tracking, and publishing workflows. You tell us what would make the machine run faster, and we build it together.



Who this role is for

You have real, demonstrable experience growing short-form content: accounts you've run or contributed to, with numbers you can show us. Views, follower growth, and ideally leads or sales driven by content

You understand the mechanics of short-form: hooks, retention curves, packaging, pacing, platform-specific behavior, and why the first two seconds d
 everything

You can write scripts, hooks, and captions in sharp, natural English that sounds like a person, not a brand account

You've coordinated production before: managing shoot schedules, briefing editors, running revisions, and hitting a publishing cadence without being chased

You're genuinely analytical: comfortable in platform analytics, honest about what's working and what isn't, and able to present findings clearly

You think in funnels, not just followers. You understand that the goal is turning attention into paying clients, and you make content decisions accordingly

You're organised enough to run a multi-platform publishing operation solo, and proactive enough that the founder never has to ask "where's this week's content?"

Strong bonus: experience with B2B, agency, or "boring niche" content (trades, local business, finance, SaaS), proving you can generate views without dancing or trends as a crutch

What we offer

$1,100-$2,000 USD/month depending on experience, and we'll go above the band for someone who can show a genuine track record of growth and conversion

13th month pay

HMO allowance after your probation period

Paid time off plus paid Philippine public holidays

Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Philippines

Direct daily collaboration with a founder who's built an audience before and treats content as a first-class growth channel, not an afterthought

An in-house videographer and editing team. You're the strategist and operator, not a one-person band doing everything

Custom tools and automations built around your role

A content function that is yours to own and shape, with a clear path to a head-of-content seat as the channel scales

How to apply



We read every application that follows these instructions, and we skip every one that doesn't.



Use the subject line: SHORT-FORM - [Your Name]

In your application, answer these four questions:

Link to 2-3 pieces of short-form content or accounts you've worked on, and tell us exactly what your role was and what the results were (real numbers, please)

In your opinion, what's the most important part of a piece of short-form content, and why?

Describe how you'd structure a split test to find our best-performing content format in the first 60 days

Lastly: what makes a good hook, in your opinion?

Optional but strongly encouraged: include a short Loom or video (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself and walking through a piece of content you're proud of and why it worked. Applicants who do this go to the top of the pile.

title: Scriptwriter compilation channel YouTube
description:
Scriptwriter Wanted – YouTube Compilation Channel



Type: Freelance, part-time / temporary basis to start and if the cooperation works well and there's room to grow, expanding the role is definitely a possibility

Workload: Multiple videos per month (to be discussed)

Language: English (native or near-native level)



About the channel

NatureUntamed is a growing YouTube channel producing compilation videos across a range of dramatic/real-footage topics — animal attacks, CCTV i
, car crashes, and similar. Content needs to be gripping and well-paced, but also accurate: viewers and the channel's credibility suffer when facts are wrong (e.g. misidentifying an animal, getting details of an i
 wrong).



How the workflow works

You won't be starting from a blank page. For each video you'll receive:

- A reference video and title to base the script on

- Competitor scripts to match in tone, structure, and pacing

- Access to a pre-configured Claude Project set up to help you write in the channel's specific style

- ElevenLabs for generating the voiceover once the script is approved



Your job is to use these tools well — pull the right facts, keep the narrative tight and engaging, and produce a script that's ready for voiceover with minimal revisions.



Responsibilities

- Source clips with a strong instinct for what will make viewers say "WOW" — content that hooks people in the first few seconds

- Write scripts for compilation videos based on supplied reference material and competitor scripts

- Use the provided Claude Project to draft in the correct channel style

- Correctly identify animals, i
, and details; verify facts before including them, if you name an animal; name the correct one (for exaple moose versus elk)

- Structure scripts for strong retention (pacing and hooks matter; AVD is our key metric)

- Generate voiceover via ElevenLabs once script is finalized

- Process feedback and revisions quickly, and stay flexible as direction and instructions shift week to week



What you bring

- Proven experience writing scripts for YouTube (compilation, true-crime/CCTV, wildlife, or similar factual/dramatic content is a plus)

- Strong research instincts and attention to detail — you double-check facts rather than guess

- Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ElevenLabs) as part of your workflow

- A real feel for how emotion drives viewer behavior — you can tell which clips give a "WOW" feeling and instantly hook someone in the first few seconds

- Strong sense of pacing, hooks, and retention

- Flexible and quick to adapt — direction and instructions can change from one week to the next, and you're comfortable adjusting on short notice

- Reliable with deadlines, responsive to feedback, able to act on it quickly rather than needing multiple rounds

- Available samples of previous scriptwriting work



To apply, please send

1. A short introduction and relevant experience

2. 2–3 sample scripts (compilation, true-crime/CCTV, wildlife, or similar preferred)

3. Availability (how many scripts per month) and rate per script,. please also include bulk pricing (e.g. 5 - 10 scripts) 



Please include the word "moose" somewhere in your reply; this confirms you've read the full post.



Note

- Accuracy matters as much as storytelling on this channel, factual errors (wrong species, wrong details) directly hurt the channel's credibility and performance, so please only apply if you're comfortable doing the research legwork.

- This is a project on parttime, temporarily basis, biut if the cooperation works well and there is room for expansion, than that is definitely a possibility.
